data_fields.name: recognize_range_mode
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 (screen shape) in shipped config; 20 when absent

data_fields.name: screen_outer_window
data_fields.donor_constant: 17..43 on a corner distance offset by 15

best_idea: Each tick, the server diffs a player's known set against the entities within range, sends one spawn when something enters and one despawn when something leaves, and keeps enter and leave radii apart so an edge crossing does not flicker.
decision_why: Keep the enter-then-leave diff with one packet per change and the screen as a data shape; add the hysteresis margin, the spatial query and the dirty flag the donor lacks, since the donor's linear scan and shared threshold would not hold at a many-player zone.
acceptance: Server test: one player and one creature on the screen edge, the player moves back and forth across the boundary 10 times; at most one spawn and one despawn per crossing band, and the known set matches the spatial query each tick.
